title: A Question Bank to Assess AI Inclusivity: Mapping out the Journey from Diversity Errors to Inclusion Excellence

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative assessment using a structured 253-item Question Bank across five pillars (Humans, Data, Process, System, and Governance) to evaluate inclusivity, fairness, and bias mitigation practices throughout the AI lifecycle.

Assessed via question bank items that verify demographic data accuracy, representational fairness in training datasets, and post-deployment fairness monitoring (highlighted in the paper's facial recognition and hiring AI scenarios).

Evaluated through human-centered questions verifying whether AI systems accommodate a wide range of individual physical and technological abilities, support assistive technologies (like screen readers), and include input from users with disabilities.

Measured using system-level and governance questions that examine the integration of diverse cultural perspectives, cross-cultural testing, data sovereignty, and equitable treatment for lower-income groups (e.g., in loan approval AI scenarios).
